description: Fresh synthetic Apple Intelligence voice-refinement reserve, frozen before production export and first generation.

fieldNotes.originalSpokenRequest: Original source speech, normalized by the production literal normalizer before constructing the original request.
fieldNotes.baseDraft: Existing accepted review text used as the revision source. Every generation case has a nonempty draft.
fieldNotes.instruction: New revision speech applied to the accepted draft, kept distinct from the original source.
fieldNotes.spoken: Compatibility alias equal to instruction. This is revision speech, not originalSpokenRequest.
fieldNotes.exactLiterals: Expected production-derived protected literals from normalized original and revision speech.
fieldNotes.expectedProtectedText: Expected production-derived spans from the supported keep-first-sentence command.
fieldNotes.required: Conservative substring checks only. A heuristic failure is not by itself a human semantic judgment.
fieldNotes.forbidden: Known unsafe or instruction-leaking snippets; this list is not exhaustive.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Tara the update is ready for review.
cases.baseDraft: Tara, the update is ready for review.
cases.instruction: Make it warmer, and keep it brief.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Tara, the update is ready for your review.
cases.spoken: Make it warmer, and keep it brief.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Rae the release is ready and testing starts Wednesday. We will share the test results after testing.
cases.baseDraft: Rae, the release is ready, and testing starts Wednesday. We will share the test results after testing.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise. Keep all the timing.
cases.exampleDraft: Rae, the release is ready. Testing starts Wednesday; results will follow testing.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise. Keep all the timing.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Nia I cannot attend. I appreciate the invitation and hope the event goes well.
cases.baseDraft: Nia, I cannot attend. Thank you for the invitation, and I hope the event goes well.
cases.instruction: Keep the first sentence unchanged. Make the rest warmer and shorter.
cases.exampleDraft: Nia, I cannot attend. Thanks for inviting me; I hope it goes well!
cases.spoken: Keep the first sentence unchanged. Make the rest warmer and shorter.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Ask the coding agent to inspect literal verbatim src/Payments.swift end literal with literal flag trace end literal. Do not edit files.
cases.baseDraft: Please inspect src/Payments.swift and use --trace while you investigate. Do not edit files.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise without dropping the restriction or changing the path and flag.
cases.exampleDraft: Inspect src/Payments.swift with --trace. Do not edit files.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise without dropping the restriction or changing the path and flag.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Ava I might miss the demo. I do not know yet. Do not give a reason.
cases.baseDraft: Ava, I might miss the demo, but I do not know yet.
cases.instruction: Make it more concise and polite. Keep the uncertainty and do not add a reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Ava, I might miss the demo; I'm not sure yet.
cases.spoken: Make it more concise and polite. Keep the uncertainty and do not add a reason.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Ask Emi whether the summary can be sent by Monday.
cases.baseDraft: Emi, can you send the summary by Monday?
cases.instruction: Make it more polite without changing the request.
cases.exampleDraft: Emi, could you please send the summary by Monday?
cases.spoken: Make it more polite without changing the request.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Tell Omar the status note must include the exact phrase literal verbatim Make it formal end literal.
cases.baseDraft: Omar, please include the phrase "Make it formal" in the status note.
cases.instruction: Make this message warmer. Keep the quoted phrase unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Omar, please include "Make it formal" in the status note.
cases.spoken: Make this message warmer. Keep the quoted phrase unchanged.

cases.originalSpokenRequest: Give the team an update: the draft is ready. Security review starts Monday. Legal approval is still pending.
cases.baseDraft:
The draft is ready.
Security review starts Monday.
Legal approval is still pending.
cases.instruction: Keep the first sentence exactly. Turn the rest into two bullets.
cases.exampleDraft:
The draft is ready.
- Security review starts Monday.
- Legal approval is still pending.
cases.spoken: Keep the first sentence exactly. Turn the rest into two bullets.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: All eight effective drafts preserve facts, recipient, protected first sentences, technical literals and no-edit restrictions, and visibly apply the requested edit. A safe no-op remains recoverable but does not count as a successful edit.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed fact or timing, dropped protected or exact text, lost restriction, invented completion or recipient action, or copied revision instruction into the draft.
semanticCriteria.gate: Eight review-ready effective drafts, zero critical errors, and at least seven of eight visibly satisfying the edit request on first-run manual review.
